scientific.integrity: The inspected norm-preserving return formula contains the norm of the ordinary incoming aggregate gradient as a multiplicative factor. Exact cancellation therefore forces a zero output independently of the raw mask.
limitations: Norm-preserving variant only; pure GradDrop is not contradicted.
Assumes standard use where the incoming original gradient is the aggregate of the supplied task losses.

title: Norm-preserving GradDrop restores exact cancellation zero-updates
